verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect documents its own recurring schedule for one automated job: you can set how often automatic payouts run for connected accounts. That is a true recurring schedule, not a one-off action, but it covers only payouts, with no general scheduler for arbitrary jobs or workflows. missing for 10: general-purpose job/workflow scheduling, scheduling of tasks other than payouts, in-depth documentation of schedule options, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Schedule the frequency of automatic payouts
